newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume jumped to 1,225 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 996 kilos with banks continuing to arbitrage deals for a second consequtive day, dealers said.
"We can say that the vast majority of trade was due to the banks engaging in arbitrage," one dealer said.

Gold eased to $353.50 an ounce in the morning when the bulk of the arbitrage deals were done as banks aimed to benefit from lower gold prices and a strong dollar against the lira. 1,025 kilos of trade took place in the first session.

But gold firmed in the afternoon to close at $354.60 an ounce, up from Monday's $353.70 in line with the world trends. In lira terms, gold rose to 1,303,200 per gram from 1,299,300 at Monday's close due to the weakening of the lira.
The lira eased to 114,180 to the dollar from Monday's 114,150 close. Of the day's 1,225 kilos trade, 61.6 percent was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
